notes.title: Storage Update Improvements V0.42
notes.notes:
[i]Notes:[/i]

[list]
[*] Hardware and snacks can now be interacted with in the player inventory
[*] Added a light switch
[*] Improved store brightness
[*] When purchasing multiple products, only one box is spawned (previously a new box would spawn every time the purchase button is pressed)
[*] Boxes can now hold an infinite amount of a product (previously boxes could only exceed the storage limit when placed on a storage shelf)
[*] Products in storage now appear in the player hotbar when interacting with a shelf. Placing items will prioritize the player inventory before taking from the storage room
[*] Employees no longer need to enter the storage room to grab products
[*] Added an inventory app to the computer
[*] Added the ability to set custom prices
[*] Added a "deposit items" box to the storage room. The player can select any items in their inventory and they will be automatically placed in storage
[*] Fixed a bug that caused customers to enter while the store is closed
[/list]
